label: Pentagon, VA
sub: AATIP/AARO headquarters — center of official UAP investigation and disclosure policy. July 21, 2026: AARO released its FY2025 annual report months after the statutory deadline — 319 new cases, 205 unresolved. label: US Capitol, DC

DIA did not respond to the financial allegation. PURSUE total: 338 files across four tranches as of July 10.

label: National Press Club, DC

label: DoW / PURSUE Portal
sub: PURSUE Tranche 1 (May 8) through Tranche 5 (Aug 7): 379 total declassified UAP files at war.gov/UFO. Tranche 4 (Jul 10, 40 files) included the 2015 Pantex nuclear-facility drone intrusion; Tranche 5 (Aug 7, 41 files) included a 2021 Gulf of Oman UAP swarm reported by Special Operations forces and a 2002 Afghanistan triangle-object account. DoW reports 1.7B+ hits on the portal since May 8 launch.

label: Lake Huron, MI
sub: Feb 12, 2023 — F-16 shoots down unidentified octagonal object over Lake Huron (one of three objects downed in post-balloon incident). Video released in PURSUE Tranche 2 (May 22, 2026). Object remains officially unidentified.

label: NSA HQ, Fort Meade, MD
sub: May 18, 2026 — NSA releases 300+ pages of Top Secret UMBRA-classified UAP records via FOIA (Disclosure Foundation). Documents dating to the 1960s show UAPs tracked within SIGINT collection systems for decades. Includes 13-fighter-jet scramble account.

label: Pantex Plant, Amarillo, TX
sub: Sept 1, 2015 — Ground radar detected a silent, diamond-shaped object on a non-threatening northerly track near the Pantex nuclear-weapons facility; two security officers pursued it for several miles but could not intercept it. Declassified and released as part of PURSUE Tranche 4 (July 10, 2026).

label: Off Virginia Coast
sub: Disclosed July 21, 2026 in AARO's FY2025 annual report — a U.S. Navy report of roughly 100 unidentified airborne objects and two likely uncrewed surface systems, the fiscal year's only maritime-domain UAP case. AARO says it is actively investigating; precise sighting date not yet public.

label: US Capitol — NDAA Amendment
sub: July 22, 2026 — House adopted Rep. Eric Burlison's UAP Disclosure Act as an amendment to the FY2027 NDAA, creating a statutory framework for a National Archives UAP Records Collection and an independent Records Review Board. Senate concurrence still required.

label: Russell Senate Office Building, DC
sub: June 25, 2026 — Disclosure Foundation's 'Disclosure Forum 2026' in the Kennedy Caucus Room convened Sens. Rounds and Gillibrand, Reps. Luna, Burchett, Burlison, and Subramanyam, plus Avi Loeb and other scientists. Sen. Rounds pledged to revive the UAP Disclosure Act after its third straight NDAA exclusion.
